Use this to make a readable report or a backup copy. The bundle format also moves your journal to another machine.

## CLI: gournal export

Write journal entries as Markdown or CSV, or write a full bundle for backup and import. The project, tag, and date options apply to md and csv only. Output goes to the terminal unless you pass --output.

```text
gournal export [options]
```

### Options

| Option | Description | Default |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| `-f, --format <format>` | Output format: md (Markdown) or csv. Use bundle for a full backup that gournal import reads. | `"md"` |
| `-p, --project <project>` | Only entries of this project. |  |
| `-t, --tags <tags>` | Only entries that have all of these tags. Separate tags with commas. |  |
| `--from <date>` | Only entries from this date (inclusive). Use a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. |  |
| `--to <date>` | Only entries up to this date (inclusive). Use a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. |  |
| `-o, --output <file>` | Write the output to this file instead of the terminal. |  |

## MCP tool: export_entries

Export journal entries as Markdown or CSV, oldest first. When more entries exist than `limit`, a second text block carries a notice.

### Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `format` | `"md" \| "csv"` | no | Output format: md (Markdown) or csv. Default: `"md"`. |
| `project` | `string` | no | Only entries of this project. |
| `tags` | `string[]` | no | Only entries that have all of these tags. |
| `from` | `string` | no | Only entries from this date (inclusive). Use a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. |
| `to` | `string` | no | Only entries up to this date (inclusive). Use a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Most entries to return. The maximum is 2000. The newest entries are kept. Default: `200`. |

### Output

This tool returns text content. It has no structured output.

## Examples

### CLI

Export the entries of one project as Markdown.

```console
$ gournal export -p billing-api
# Gournal Export

## billing-api

- `2026-11-15 23:25` Fix rounding error in invoice totals

Totals were off by one cent when a discount applied after tax. (#review)
- `2026-11-15 23:25` Add keyboard focus styles to the invoice date picker (#ui)
- `2026-11-15 23:25` Document the invoice export endpoint (#docs)
- `2026-11-15 23:25` Cannot reproduce the failing webhook retry in staging
- `2026-11-15 23:25` Add a regression test for tax rounding (#review)
```

Export entries that have a tag as CSV.

```console
$ gournal export -f csv -t ui
timestamp,project,message,tags,summary,details,kind,refs
2026-11-15T21:25:18.173Z,billing-api,Add keyboard focus styles to the invoice date picker,ui,Add keyboard focus styles to the invoice date picker,,done,
2026-11-15T21:25:18.174Z,worker,Move the settings page to the new form components,ui,Move the settings page to the new form components,,done,
2026-11-15T21:25:18.175Z,worker,Review the queue backoff change,review;ui,Review the queue backoff change,,done,
```
